gloss: inevitably; necessarily; as a natural consequence

definitions.gloss: inevitably; necessarily; as a natural consequence
definitions.explanation: Something that happens as a logical or unavoidable result of circumstances. Indicates that an outcome was bound to occur given the conditions.

examples.japanese: {必然的|ひつぜんてき}にそう⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It will inevitably turn out that way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えれば→増える：01183_fueru⟧、{必然的|ひつぜんてき}に⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{需要|じゅよう}→需要：02616_juyou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: If the population increases, the demand for food will inevitably increase as well.

examples.japanese: ⟦グローバル{化|か}→グローバル化：30240_guroobaruka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}めば→進む：01225_susumu⟧、{必然的|ひつぜんてき}に⟦{異文化|いぶんか}→異文化：15703_ibunka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{接触|せっしょく}→接触：12904_sesshoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧いく。
examples.english: As globalization advances, contact with different cultures inevitably increases.

notes:
USAGE:
⟦{必然|ひつぜん}→必然：05533_hitsuzen⟧ means "inevitability" or "necessity" and ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ makes it an adverb. Used in logical arguments, analysis, and formal writing to describe outcomes that follow naturally from given conditions. More formal and analytical than ⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧ (certainly, always).

The na-adjective form {必然的|ひつぜんてき}な is also common: {必然的|ひつぜんてき}な⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ (an inevitable result).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {必然的|ひつぜんてき}に⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧ (to arise inevitably)
- {必然的|ひつぜんてき}な⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ (an inevitable result)
- {必然的|ひつぜんてき}な⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧ (an inevitable trend)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧: certainly, always — more everyday, less analytical
- ⟦{当然|とうぜん}→当然：01591_touzen⟧: naturally, of course — implies something is expected or obvious
- ⟦{不可避|ふかひ}→不可避：15524_fukahi⟧: unavoidable — a more formal noun/na-adjective
